title: Mastering CSS 'font-display' for Optimal Web Font Loading & Seamless UI Experience
tweet: Boost web font performance & UX! Learn how CSS 'font-display' controls font loading behavior, preventing disruptive flashes. Crucial for #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign #UX
tip: Optimize your site's perceived performance and user experience by intelligently controlling web font loading behavior with the CSS 'font-display' descriptor. Instead of letting browsers decide how to handle font loading (which can lead to a 'Flash of Unstyled Text' (FOUT) or 'Flash of Invisible Text' (FOIT)), 'font-display' allows you to specify a strategy. For most content-heavy sites, 'font-display: swap' is highly recommended as it displays text immediately with a fallback font and swaps in the web font once it's loaded, prioritizing content readability. Other values like 'fallback', 'optional', and 'block' offer fine-tuned control for different UX priorities, helping mitigate layout shifts and improve perceived speed.
